cases.text: Namaste Anjali Verma, 3 Nov Tuesday ko Morning shift 07:00-15:00 cover karne ke liye request hai. Aap standby par hain isliye aapko contact kiya hai, isse sirf 1 changed cell hoga aur aap rank 1 par hain. Kripya Accept ya Decline tap karein.

Namaste Neha Gupta, kya aap 4 Nov Wednesday Evening shift (15:00-23:00) cover kar sakte hain? Aapko isliye choose kiya kyunki isse sirf 1 duty change hoga aur aap rank 1 par hain - is period me aapke sabse kam shifts hain. Kripya Accept ya Decline tap karein. Dhanyavaad!
Hi Kavya Reddy, could you cover the Night shift on 5 Nov (Thursday 23:00-07:00)? You were selected as rank 1 and this option changes only 3 cells. Please tap Accept or Decline. Thank you!
